key_insight: Generative Meta-Learning with Human Feedback uses expert beliefs to steer synthetic data generation toward an unseen target distribution, improving generalization under distribution shift.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical human-in-the-loop path for building robust digital twins and meta-learners when target-domain data are scarce or unavailable.
method: Uses a Conditional Neural ODE (cNODE) as a generative digital twin to synthesize trajectories.
A Reinforcement Learning agent updates latent physical parameters based on expert feedback.
Theoretical bounds link lower distribution divergence to reduced generalization risk.
evidence_signal: Experiments on a nonlinear Duffing oscillator and a probabilistic non-dynamical model show lower deployment loss and reduced divergence as feedback reliability increases.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and reliability of human feedback, so noisy or biased expert input could misguide the learned target distribution.
paper_title: Human-Machine Collaboration on Generative Meta-Learning: Model and Algorithm
